name: stddoc-flint-bake
description: Live Flint bake for std-doc (engine #3, Slice 1): a Flint chart spec -> Vega-Lite -> inline SVG, in pure Node (no browser). Optional: only needed to render Flint charts FROM a spec at publish time. The Slice-0 embed path (name a chart -> pre-baked catalog SVG) needs no Node at all.
